question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Avarise**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given question, the word in option 1 is incorrect.**
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is 'Avarice'. **
 
• "Avarice" means extreme greed for wealth or material gain.
 
 
• Example: His avarice led him to embezzle company funds.
 
 
 
• The words in other given options have accurate spellings.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Adverse) means unfavorable or harmful.
 
• Option 3 (Beige) is correctly spelled and means a pale sandy yellowish-brown color.
 
• Option 4 (Admonish) means to warn or reprimand someone firmly.
